sections.name: mission
sections.value: Build exactly u3: governance records: project/stream/fence/dispatch/ack/canary/attest/task/node/baton/prime. Additive routes and verbs over the existing tables; dispatch carries a packet pointer with a three-state receipt (queued/delivered/acked) riding /v1/send; node show renders the tree from rs rows. PM owns final composition and validation; prime owns product scope and production deploy.

value.text: FIRST use /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-rs-governance-port-u3 as cwd and ABSOLUTE paths for every tool operation. Spawn directory is main; never edit main. Load BOTH skill://pij and skill://builder, then this packet and contracts. Your model must be omp github-copilot/gpt-6-astra-1m high, not inferred from requested argv.

ACK before editing: quote `pij whoami` identity and the actual OMP footer model line, your absolute worktree root, unit scope, numbered implementation plan, and concrete seam doubts. Reply via pij_send to pij-lonely-ikrie. No code until PM rules the ack.

Read only your unit/phase plus governance-routes.json and governance-events.json. Implement only contract rows owned by you. Contract changes require PM then prime ack; no silent alternate schemas or naming.

Write named observable regression tests first; tests must consume u0 JSON fixture cases/payloads, not restate values in independent constants. Include a baseline-compatible HTTP/CLI case that demonstrably fails against the pre-fix daemon. PM already reproduced u1 baseline control; receipt is baseline-fanout-red.json.

CONCURRENT EDIT WAVE: skip ALL builds, formatters, linters, test runs, harness boot/checks and commit hooks for now. Do not commit yet. Write code/tests and report READY_TO_VALIDATE with exact commands and baseline-compatible test names, then hold. PM runs verification after all wave edits pause, composes, commits, and reports acceptance. This is not permission to claim DONE without proof.

No shared wiring edits: PM owns daemon http/mod.rs route and AppState wiring, daemon lib.rs construction, CLI main.rs command wiring, and common lib.rs exports/migration registration. Ship an exact snap-in recipe in assets/receipt-u3.json (requested artifact) naming types, constructors, call order and match arms. If an exported type requires caller changes, use LSP references and enumerate those callers in recipe.

All future runtime proof MUST copy isolation recipe from governance-routes.json#isolation: private PORT + --state-dir + HOME + CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + XDG_CONFIG_HOME + TMUX socket for daemon AND clients. Never bind 7461, restart prod, run flowspace3 daemon, npm install/ci in main, alter main node_modules/global links/settings, or run omp update. No live fleet probes except ordinary pij peer messages/status cards.

Use flowspace3 search before meaning-shaped discovery (client only; healthy on 7373), exact grep for identifiers, and LSP for references/definitions/refactors. Report real misses/friction with harness observe; never drain/clear buffers. No reading pij inbox transport logs.

Status card at work start and end with pij-rs report now. Use pij_send for every PM message, concise pointer delivery. If you use internal scout agents, prime/PM messages can be misrouted into them: explicitly relay any parent instructions back to your main context.

READY_TO_VALIDATE receipt includes exact changed paths, tests authored, baseline RED strategy, snap-in recipe, toolchain versions, and ASSUMPTIONS about sibling call order/store state/event ownership. No stubs, placeholder implementations, fake fallback, or unimplemented subverbs. Do not merge/open PR/deploy.
The PM is your interface: acks, questions, done reports. You never message prime or Jordan directly unless the PM's seat is dead.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.

value.forbidden_note: Never write main, another unit worktree, node_modules, global links/settings, live daemon, port7461, .harness/government/**, .the-flow-state.json, the-flow.json, or the-flow.md. No migrations except owned number: u3=0014; u1/u2 none. ABSOLUTE FILE PATHS ONLY.

value.text: Every owned contract behavior is implemented, including refusal/boundary cases; test fixtures reference u0 canonical JSON.
Named baseline-compatible regression tests and focused tests are provided; PM must run and record RED/GREEN before acceptance.
After concurrent editing is paused, PM validates composed tree and full harness checks. READY_TO_VALIDATE is a checkpoint, never a DONE claim.
Exact snap-in recipe, changed paths, composition assumptions, and original .harness/temp buffers supplied to PM. No cross-unit wiring changes.
